changeOrders.current: Header lacks a theme toggle button (evidence: S-001 dom: #theme-toggle not found).
changeOrders.desired: A <button id="theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle theme"> placed at the right end of the header, minimum 44x44px touch target, that switches html[data-theme] between dark and light.
changeOrders.visionNote: Theme toggle is a core accessibility and user-preference feature required by the design system (A2).

changeOrders.current: Promo strip has fixed width 640px causing horizontal overflow at 375px viewport (evidence: S-001 page: scrollWidth=660 clientWidth=375).
changeOrders.desired: Promo strip must be responsive and not exceed viewport width at any breakpoint (375, 768, 1280). Use max-width: 100% or fluid width.
changeOrders.visionNote: Mobile-first layout (A3) requires no horizontal scrolling at 375px; promo strip must adapt to viewport.

changeOrders.current: Lead paragraph uses text-transform: uppercase (evidence: S-001 dom: p.lead textTransform=uppercase).
changeOrders.desired: Lead paragraph must use sentence case with text-transform: none (or no text-transform), per A1 typography rules.
changeOrders.visionNote: Typography consistency (A1) forbids all-caps; sentence case improves readability and brand voice.
